description: Section 8.3 and the rule that list and automated mail is not shown as chats: list fields, Precedence, Auto-Submitted, the null Return-Path and no-reply senders are classified; a local part that only starts like noreply is a person; the owner's own message is a person whatever its fields. The chats view groups only the person messages.
